data.description: You gain a gaze attack that causes foes within 30 feet to become shaken for 1 round unless they succeed at a Will save (DC %1). You can suppress this ability as a free action and cause it to resume as a swift action. A creature that succeeds at the saving throw is immune to your regretful gaze for 24 hours.|10+TL/2+ShadowboundManifestationLevel
